author: skyzhishui
description: NoriFlow 长期记忆框架：对话自动落盘长期记忆，通过向量检索+重排序完成记忆召回并注入上下文；基于事实簇表确定性拼装用户画像；内置LLM主动记忆工具，附带WebUI可视化记忆维护界面。存储后端二选一：PostgreSQL+pgvector 或 SQLite（零外部服务）。

en.description: NoriFlow long-term memory framework: conversations are automatically persisted to long-term memory; recall combines vector retrieval with rerank and injects the results into context; user personas are deterministically assembled from the fact-cluster table; includes built-in LLM active memory tools and a WebUI visual memory maintenance page.
